description: A small round zen garden dish filled with white sand sits on the table, with a tiny gray figurine and a small white stone inside, and a yellow mini rake is being used over the sand. The left hand hovers near the dish to steady it without grasping, while the right hand holds the rake and drags it through the sand in short arcs from the upper-right area toward the lower-left, then sweeps around the stone to smooth and refresh the curved grooves before lifting slightly away.
